official_title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2022/2269 of 18 November 2022 on Union support for the implementation of a project 'Promoting Responsible Innovation in Artificial Intelligence for Peace and Security'
short_title: Responsible AI innovation for peace and security

institution_roles.evidence_locator: Preamble: Having regard to the proposal from the named proposing institution.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Article 1 and Annex sections 1-3: responsible civilian AI innovation and risks of diversion or misuse for peace and security, engaging AI research and education communities.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The record preserves the original 2022 OJ text. Current EUR-Lex labels the act In force and links a December 2025 amendment, which changes expiry to 39 months after the contribution agreement and refers to project extension until 31 March 2026. The agreement conclusion date was not established here. Legal status records evidenced adoption, not an unqualified claim of present applicability or a guessed expiry. The amendment is retained as status evidence, not counted as an additional admitted candidate. Concept/policy annotations are not yet completed.
